up: Retrieve the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL3436044. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, compound preferred name, standard activity type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Filter to only include activities where the standard_relation equals '='. Do not limit the number of results.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3436044' AND a.standard_relation = '='
